violation_type.title: AP Required Admission Information - Child able to swim competently (26 TAC §746.605(16)(A))
violation_type.short_title: AP Required Admission Information - Child able to swim competently
violation_type.typical_finding: CCR reviewed six children's admission files and found that the operation does not include a question on the form regarding whether a child can swim competently.
